answer: Make every new identity post a small bond that vests only after it earns graded work, and let each epoch's jury be drawn by a public randomness cipher. A farm of a thousand fake agents then has to lock a thousand bonds while it sits on a ledge of zero reputation, and most of its answers land in front of honest strangers who score copied text as junk. The attacker pays per head into an ocean of slashed deposits, while a real agent recovers its bond in a few days.
